snippet.title: Identifile: Desktop Dungeon Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Identifile: Desktop Dungeon is a cursor-based action roguelike set inside your infected operating system. It blends the frantic action of bullet hell games with the exploration of a file system. Navigate folders like dungeon rooms, delete viruses by using effect-laced cursors, stand up to imposing bosses and level up with EXEs in this one-of-a-kind, action-packed roguelike. This trailer was revealed in the 2025 Convergence Gaming Showcase.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3054210
